messages:
Jin Park: Hey team — prepping the canary rollout for v2 inference in APAC. Trying to open the APAC Service Overview and Model Health panels but both give 403s. Can someone either share the shortlinks or unblock me? :wave:
Elena Morales: Which exact links are you hitting? We split region panels into folders last month, might be a permissions group mismatch.
Jin Park: Thanks — the URLs I tried: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/serv-overview/apac-service-overview and https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/model-health/apac-model-health. Error: "You do not have permission to view this dashboard (HTTP 403)"
ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: Canary rollout for service-inference-v2 scheduled for 2024-06-05 18:00 UTC. No config changes yet.
Mike Chen: @Elena can you confirm whether jpark is in the ops-readonly-apac group? If not I can open an RBAC ticket or add him temporarily. :thumbsup:
Elena Morales: Jin, you should be in ops-readonly-apac but I see you in ops-readonly-eu instead. We'll need identity sync. Two options: I can add you to the APAC view group (fast) or we open a short-lived invite for the rollout. Which do you prefer?
Jin Park: Fast add would be great. Can we limit it to just dashboard view? Need it for ~4 hours during rollout.
Samir Patel: FWIW, if you need traces/errs too, service traces are at https://tempo.internal.redwood/explore?orgId=1&query=service%3Ainference-apac and Loki logs: https://loki.internal.redwood/streams?query=%22inference-apac%22. Those also follow same RBAC groups.
Elena Morales: Ok, adding now. Command I ran: ```
# add Jin to APAC view group (identity service)
identityctl group add-member --group ops-readonly-apac --member jpark@redwood.com --expires 4h
```
Elena Morales: You should have access in ~2 minutes, try the links again. :white_check_mark:
Jin Park: Confirmed — both dashboards load now. Cheers! Quick ask: can someone pin the service-overview link in the ops workspace so it's easier for the oncall to find during the rollout?
Mike Chen: I'll pin it and add a short playbook note in the ops workspace. Also adding a Grafana short alias: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/ops/apac-inference (internal only).
Jin Park: Perfect. Thanks all.
Elena Morales: Leaving a follow-up ticket to sync identity groups across regions so this doesn't repeat: TICKET-8241.
ops-bot: SRE tasks: Ticket TICKET-8241 created and assigned to elena.m.
Mike Chen: Nice. If anyone else hits 403s ping #eng-platform or DM me.
